name: Game-controlled collision for world entities
body: The Guide Light hides platforms until her glow reaches them. `lantern:::world:::SetVisible` hides the mesh but the collider stays, so the game would have to move hidden pieces away to switch them off. Add `lantern:::world:::SetSolid(entity, solid)` so a hidden piece can't be stood on. Until then the game moves hidden pieces 1000 m down with `Teleport` and says so in a comment; it is a workaround to remove when this lands.
